text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Mmhmm.
Nature-san, Make Debut... got it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hey there.
Just blew 'em all away, haha.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So? How did you like...
my running?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
You sure are decisive.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Then let's keep that sharp, decisive momentum
and take the next race too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I want to know
how Trainer sees the future.
choice_data_list: By the way, is there a race you're aiming for?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...
A goal, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man, do you really think I'm in any position
to be talking about goals right now?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's fine for you to take the lead here, Trainer.
Come on, show us what you've got~

I've felt this since before her debut, but Nice Nature is built for medium distances.
Her late burst is sharp, and she can hold her ground when it counts.
"To gauge how the upcoming Classic campaign will unfold, the first race we should choose is—"
choice_data_list: Why not run the Wakagoma Stakes?
Would you like to run the Wakagoma Stakes?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho, I see, I see.
So you want to see what they've got in the open races, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good.
I shall accept.
choice_data_list: Let's deliver solid results, just like always.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Like always...?
Does that mean you want me to take 3rd place, yes?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I'm aiming
for 3rd place, you know.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...That's just how it turned out, is all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, there are a few monsters out there
who consistently take 1st place, but still...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder what Teio's gonna do. What race is she gonna run?

Tokai Teio debuted around the same time as Nice Nature.
It's no wonder she's bothered by it.
However...
choice_data_list: Training comes first, above all else!
Training comes first, above all else!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I know that.
I just thought it'd be nice if we didn't bump into each other~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well then, once again,
I look forward to your continued favor~
And so, the next goal was set: the Wakagoma Stakes!
